# OpenTaint

> OpenTaint is the open source engine for continuous, lean, and agentic application security testing. It turns agent-led security reviews into repeatable vulnerability checks for every change.

Security agents use OpenTaint skills to discover application-specific trust boundaries and vulnerability patterns, then preserve that review knowledge as taint rules and dependency models. OpenTaint applies those artifacts with deterministic program analysis instead of asking a model to rediscover the same facts on every scan.

OpenTaint integrates with GitHub Actions and GitLab CI to run repeatable vulnerability checks and produce SARIF results on pull requests and CI/CD builds. It tracks untrusted values from sources to security-sensitive sinks across methods, fields, framework code, async boundaries, and persistence.

OpenTaint currently supports Java and Kotlin, with deep Spring support. Python, Go, C#, JavaScript, and TypeScript are on the roadmap and are not yet supported.

The core engine is Apache 2.0 licensed. The CLI, CI integrations, and rules are MIT licensed and may be used on public, private, and commercial codebases.

## Blog and guides

- [Taint analysis guide](https://opentaint.org/blog/what-is-taint-analysis/): Definition, source-to-sink model, analysis depth, and tool evaluation criteria.
- [Documentation](https://github.com/seqra/opentaint/blob/main/docs/README.md): Installation, configuration, rules, and CLI usage.
- [Source code](https://github.com/seqra/opentaint): OpenTaint repository.
- [Semgrep vs. CodeQL vs. OpenTaint](https://opentaint.org/blog/semgrep-vs-codeql-vs-opentaint/): Java XSS analysis-depth comparison.
- [Taint analysis for Spring](https://opentaint.org/blog/spring-analyzer/): Dependency injection and persistence analysis examples.
- [CVE-2026-58138 case study](https://opentaint.org/blog/conductor-rce-cve-2026-58138/): Reproducible real-world finding and rule.
- [AppSec Agent](https://opentaint.org/blog/appsec-agent/): How agent review produces reusable rules and dependency models.
